name: Breathing / HRV
description: Breathing and HRV regulation exercise to calm the rider's nervous system and support steady focus.
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this breathing focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Inhale 4, exhale 6 — 6–8 cycles. Say it: ‘Rhythm before results.’.  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breath cycles, then return to normal riding and notice any shift in your body and your horse.
evidence_base: Heart-rate variability (HRV) biofeedback, breathwork research, and sports performance breathing protocols.
